source_selection: First indexed April2024 Eclipse Soundscapes deployment found by sequentially searching ESID104 then ESID105; different from prior ESID103. No spectral or aircraft-fit evidence used.
interval_rule: First nonempty April8,2024 waveform beginning at or after16:00:00UTC; retain its first600seconds, or concatenate immediately consecutive files only when original format and filename/header UTC prove sample-contiguous coverage. If a gap occurs first, retain the shorter contiguous run and report it; do not screen for an event.
review_protocol: Send root only waveform-derived plots/audio, sample-zero UTC, broadregion and uncertainties. Root reviews and freezes selected traces/rejections before aircraft identities or fit results. Exact publisher coordinates and mapping metadata remain in a separate provenance/truth directory until predictions are committed.
blindness: Source-informed acquisition, reviewer-blind audio review. Public search results exposed exact publisher coordinates to the acquisition agent; strict experiment-wide blinding is not claimed.
no_event_policy: Keep no-event/insufficient-evidence outcome; do not replace the interval after listening or detection.
